en.fx_desc_blur_gaussian: Smooth, adjustable blur with a direction — you can blur a single axis.
en.fx_desc_blur_lens: Lens blur: a disc of samples shaped like the iris, where bright areas weigh more — this is bokeh, not a smear.
en.fx_desc_blur_sharpen: Brings out detail and edges without inventing texture.
en.fx_desc_blur_unsharp: A real unsharp mask: original + gain × (original − blurred), with a threshold so grain is not amplified.
en.fx_desc_color_brightness_contrast: Raises brightness and opens or closes contrast around mid grey.
en.fx_desc_color_colorama: Remaps color: each pixel's brightness becomes a position on a rotating rainbow.
en.fx_desc_color_curves: The tone curve: fine control of light and of each color channel.
en.fx_desc_color_exposure: Brightens or darkens like camera exposure: multiplies light without blowing out color.
en.fx_desc_color_invert: The negative: every color becomes its opposite, like a badly developed film.
en.fx_desc_color_levels: Sets where black starts, where white ends and where the middle sits.
en.fx_desc_color_matrix: Mixes the R, G and B channels together: swaps, adds and crosses colors.
en.fx_desc_color_saturation: Makes color more vivid, or takes everything to black and white.
en.fx_desc_color_tint: Paints the shadows one color and the highlights another — cinema duotone.
en.fx_desc_control_angle: An angle you wire into another parameter's expression.
en.fx_desc_control_checkbox: An on/off switch you wire into another parameter's expression.
en.fx_desc_control_color: A color you wire into another parameter's expression.
en.fx_desc_control_point: An X/Y point you wire into another parameter's expression.
en.fx_desc_control_slider: A value from 0 to 100 you wire into another parameter's expression.
en.fx_desc_distort_ripple_dissolve: The image vanishes in circles growing from the center with a rippling edge. Animate the progress to turn it into a transition.
en.fx_desc_distort_shake: Deterministic shake: the layer shakes the same way every time you reopen the project, with separate frequency and axes.
en.fx_desc_distort_turbulence: A noise field pushes every pixel. The field evolves over time — smoke, heat, water.
en.fx_desc_distort_warp: Lens: push, pull, twist, sphere and corner, each with its own radius and point.
en.fx_desc_distort_wave_warp: A wave crosses the image — horizontal, vertical or diagonal — and can be pinned at the edges.
en.fx_desc_glitch_cross: Two bars, one vertical and one horizontal, scan the image reading from the wrong place. Animate the progress to turn it into a transition.
en.fx_desc_glitch_glitchify: Digital glitch: the image breaks into sliding blocks, the channels split apart and whole blocks jump out of place.
en.fx_desc_glitch_signal: Broadcast signal: lost bands, slipping sync and constant drift.
en.fx_desc_glitch_uni_vhs: Stylised VHS: heavy RGB split, wobble, dirty glow and vignette — the vocabulary of tape at the service of the look.
en.fx_desc_glitch_vhs: Real VHS: blur, smeared chroma, tracking instability, tape dropouts, scanlines and color degradation.
en.fx_desc_key_chroma: Removes the green or blue background and cleans the color spill on the edge.
en.fx_desc_key_luma: Removes the black (or the white) from the layer and lets the rest show through.
en.fx_desc_light_deep_glow: Glow in two halos, one tight and one wide, each with its own color: the core blows out and the surroundings fill in.
en.fx_desc_light_glow: Spreads the light from the bright parts: the glow that comes off the screen.
en.fx_desc_light_rays: Light rays coming from a point: the brightness of the highlights spreads in straight lines.
en.fx_desc_light_sweep: A blade of light crosses the image. With relief, it lights only where the surface faces it.
en.fx_desc_stylize_film_damage: Damaged film: dust, scratches, flicker, gate weave, burns and splices — each with its own control.
en.fx_desc_stylize_grain: Film grain: crystal at whatever size you want, luma and chroma apart, stronger in the shadows.
en.fx_desc_stylize_halftone: Halftone: the image becomes dots, with the grid rotated per channel so the three screens do not fight.
en.fx_desc_stylize_holomatrix: Hologram: the image becomes a projection, with a technical grid, scanlines and interference.
en.fx_desc_stylize_jpeg_damage: JPEG damage: the blocks, the ringing on edges and color at half resolution. Quality scales all three.
en.fx_desc_stylize_minimax: Dilates or erodes what is bright: thickens or thins a cutout and cleans up a one-pixel edge.
en.fx_desc_stylize_motion_tile: Repeats the image in a mosaic until it covers the frame, with optional mirror and phase.
en.fx_desc_stylize_pixel_sort: Sorts the pixels of each row by brightness: the image melts into streaks.
en.fx_desc_stylize_scanlines: Screen scanlines: the line darkens whatever is behind it, with its own height, softness and channel.
en.fx_desc_time_echo: Leaves a trail: copies of the image itself delayed in time, with fade.
en.fx_desc_time_posterize: Locks the frame rate: the image starts moving in steps, like hand-drawn animation.
en.fx_desc_time_warp_rgb: Each color channel comes from a different instant: red from the frame behind, blue from the frame ahead.
en.fx_desc_transform: Moves, rotates, scales and changes the layer's opacity without losing quality.
en.fx_so_onde_imagem_clara: Only where the image is bright
en.pn_blend_help: Blending combines this layer with the layers below. White on Lighten covers the image; on Darken it lets the image show through. Adjust opacity as well to reduce the strength.
en.pn_env_light_hint: The environment light lights and reflects on every 3D object in the project.
en.pn_mask_pick_layer_below: Pick the layer below to fill with the mask
en.sh_add_captions_need_speech: Pick a video or audio layer to take the captions from speech.
en.sh_add_pick_layers_to_group: Pick the layers on the timeline to group.
